definitions.explanation: Having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities; overbearingly proud and looking down on others.

examples.japanese: {傲慢|ごうまん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}して→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧{傲慢|ごうまん}になった。
examples.english: He became arrogant after his success.

examples.japanese: {傲慢|ごうまん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧いく。
examples.english: If you keep acting arrogant, the people around you will drift away.
